title: A Compass for the Ledger
author: Ada Vasquez
blurb: Ivo Marchetti, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
